reading.notes: No tracklist visible. The front cover shows a photo of a smiling woman with dark hair in a dark off-shoulder top, holding a guitar in front of a tree. Handwritten in black marker: 'KÜSSE! MEHR KÜSSE!' (top left) and the signature 'Paula Linke' (bottom right). These appear to be the title and artist name, but they could also be a handwritten dedication and autograph. No label, catalogue number or barcode is visible.
